responsibility: Declares the core data structures, enums, descriptor tables, and interfaces for the x86 builtin subsystem. It includes the generated builtin type tables, defines the master enum of ix86 builtins and builtin-description records, publishes the builtin ISA descriptor arrays and helper macros for common vector signatures, and exposes the public backend entry points used by the rest of the i386 target code to declare, fold, vectorize, and expand x86 builtins.
same_name_distinction: Unlike i386-builtins.cc, which implements builtin registration and expansion logic, this header defines and exposes the builtin subsystem's interface and metadata layout, including generated type tables, builtin enums, descriptor structs, and public entry points.
